"""
Project Title: Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) Renderer in Keras (ai-ml-ds-NeRF2025)
File Name: nerf_renderer.py

Short Description:
Builds a NeRF model in Keras/TensorFlow to synthesize novel views of a synthetic 3D scene.
Encodes 3D coordinates and view directions with high-frequency Fourier features,
reconstructs RGB outputs and density via an MLP, renders rays via volumetric integration,
and demonstrates view synthesis and rendering examples.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
SEED: int = 42
tf.random.set_seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED)
D_FF: int = 256            # type: int = hidden dimension
N_LAYERS: int = 8          # type: int = MLP layers
L_POS: int = 10            # type: int = positional encoding levels
L_DIR: int = 4             # type: int = directional encoding levels
RAYS_PER_BATCH: int = 1024 # type: int = rays per batch
SAMPLES_PER_RAY: int = 64  # type: int = samples per ray
LR: float = 5e-4           # type: float = learning rate
EPOCHS: int = 1000         # type: int = epochs

# ----------------------------
# Positional Encoding
# ----------------------------
def embed(x: tf.Tensor, L: int) -> tf.Tensor:
    freqs = tf.pow(2.0, tf.range(L, dtype=tf.float32))  # (L,)
    x_exp = tf.expand_dims(x, -2) * tf.expand_dims(freqs, -1)  # (...,L,dim)
    x_sin = tf.sin(np.pi * x_exp)
    x_cos = tf.cos(np.pi * x_exp)
    return tf.concat([x_sin, x_cos], axis=-1)  # (...,2L,dim)

# ----------------------------
# NeRF Network
# ----------------------------
coord_in = Input((3,), name="coords")
dir_in = Input((3,), name="dir")
x = layers.Concatenate()([embed(coord_in, L_POS), embed(dir_in, L_DIR)])
for _ in range(N_LAYERS):
    x = layers.Dense(D_FF, activation="relu")(x)
rgb = layers.Dense(3, activation="sigmoid")(x)
sigma = layers.Dense(1, activation="relu")(x)
nerf = Model([coord_in, dir_in], [rgb, sigma], name="NeRF")

# ----------------------------
# Volume Rendering
# ----------------------------
@tf.function
def render_rays(origins, directions, nerf_model):
    B: int = tf.shape(origins)[0]
    t_vals = tf.linspace(0.,1.,SAMPLES_PER_RAY)  # (S,)
    t_vals = tf.reshape(t_vals, (1, SAMPLES_PER_RAY, 1))
    pts = origins[:,None,:] + directions[:,None,:] * t_vals  # (B,S,3)
    dirs = tf.repeat(tf.expand_dims(directions,1), SAMPLES_PER_RAY, axis=1)
    pts_flat = tf.reshape(pts, (-1,3))
    dirs_flat = tf.reshape(dirs, (-1,3))
    rgb, sigma = nerf_model([pts_flat, dirs_flat])
    rgb = tf.reshape(rgb, (B,SAMPLES_PER_RAY,3))
    sigma = tf.reshape(sigma, (B,SAMPLES_PER_RAY,1))
    deltas = t_vals[:,1:,:] - t_vals[:,:-1,:]  # (1,S-1,1)
    delta_last = tf.concat([deltas, deltas[:,:1,:]], axis=1)
    alpha = 1. - tf.exp(-sigma * delta_last)
    weights = alpha * tf.math.cumprod(1.-alpha + 1e-10, axis=1, exclusive=True)
    rgb_map = tf.reduce_sum(weights * rgb, axis=1)
    return rgb_map

# ----------------------------
# Dummy Data Generator
# ----------------------------
def gen_batch():
    origins = tf.random.uniform((RAYS_PER_BATCH,3), minval=-1, maxval=1)
    dirs = tf.random.normal((RAYS_PER_BATCH,3))
    dirs = dirs / tf.norm(dirs, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    target_rgb = tf.random.uniform((RAYS_PER_BATCH,3))
    return origins, dirs, target_rgb

# ----------------------------
# Training Loop
# ----------------------------
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    orig, dirs, tgt = gen_batch()
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        pred = render_rays(orig, dirs, nerf)
        loss = tf.reduce_mean((pred - tgt)**2)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, nerf.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, nerf.trainable_variables))
    if epoch % 100 == 0:
        tf.print("Epoch", epoch, "Loss", loss)

# ----------------------------
# Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
orig, dirs, tgt = gen_batch()
pred = render_rays(orig, dirs, nerf)
print("Ground truth RGB:", tgt.numpy()[:5])
print("Predicted RGB:", pred.numpy()[:5])

Beyond the core defaults, this NeRF project pushes Keras into volumetric rendering with high-frequency encoding, implicit neural geometry, and synthesizing realistic novel views—bridging advanced graphics and neural representation.🚀🔥😊
